verdictEs: Assistant NMS si necesitas lookup operativo rápido durante una sesión — recipes, refining, cooking, expedition trackers — con app cross-platform que vive en tu segundo monitor o teléfono. NMS Fandom Wiki si quieres contexto enciclopédico, lore, historia de patches o investigar una mecánica en profundidad.
verdictEn: Assistant NMS for fast operational lookup during a session — recipes, refining, cooking, expedition trackers — with cross-platform app that lives on your second monitor or phone. NMS Fandom Wiki for encyclopedic context, lore, patch history, or deep-diving a mechanic.

useCases.labelEs: Mid-sesión: necesitas saber qué refina un material
useCases.labelEn: Mid-session: need to know what a material refines into
useCases.reasonEs: Assistant tiene refining recipes en una sola pantalla, searchable, sin ads ni navegación entre pages. La wiki tiene la info pero requiere abrir browser, buscar, scroll — un overhead que mata el flow del juego.
useCases.reasonEn: Assistant has refining recipes on a single screen, searchable, no ads or page navigation. The wiki has the info but requires opening browser, searching, scrolling — overhead that kills game flow.

useCases.labelEs: Trackear progreso de la expedition activa
useCases.labelEn: Track progress on the active expedition
useCases.reasonEs: Assistant integra live community events y expeditions con trackers de milestones. La wiki documenta expeditions pasadas como historial pero no es operativa para la actual.
useCases.reasonEn: Assistant integrates live community events and expeditions with milestone trackers. The wiki documents past expeditions as history but isn't operational for the current one.

useCases.labelEs: Entender qué hacía Synthesis update y por qué cambió crafting
useCases.labelEn: Understand what Synthesis update did and why it changed crafting
useCases.reasonEs: La wiki tiene pages dedicadas por update con análisis editorial: qué se agregó, qué se rompió, reacción community. Assistant es presente-focused; no documenta historia.
useCases.reasonEn: The wiki has dedicated per-update pages with editorial analysis: what was added, what broke, community reaction. Assistant is present-focused; it doesn't document history.

useCases.labelEs: Cocinar un recipe complejo: necesitas los ingredientes ordenados
useCases.labelEn: Cook a complex recipe: need ingredients ordered step by step
useCases.reasonEs: Assistant tiene cooking recipes con flow estructurado paso a paso. La wiki lista ingredientes pero el flow está en prosa, menos rápido para seguir mientras crafteas.
useCases.reasonEn: Assistant has cooking recipes with structured step-by-step flow. The wiki lists ingredients but the flow is in prose, less fast to follow while crafting.

useCases.labelEs: Investigar el lore de Atlas y theory de simulation
useCases.labelEn: Research Atlas lore and simulation theory
useCases.reasonEs: La wiki tiene secciones dedicadas a lore con interpretaciones community y citas de in-game text. Assistant no toca lore — su foco es 100% operativo.
useCases.reasonEn: The wiki has dedicated lore sections with community interpretations and in-game text quotes. Assistant doesn't touch lore — its focus is 100% operational.
